d:
Navratri mehmaan ke liye ek namkeen, ek meetha: crispy Sabudana Vada + 15 min ki Vrat Jalebi!
Vada kurkura kaise bane? Sahi tarike se bhigoiye. Jalebi bina soda, bina color, desi ghee mein.
Masala Kitchen ki tried & tested vrat recipe, Poonam Devnani ke saath
krispi sabudana vara – 1 ghante men bhigone ki sahi trik
bharvan aur bina philing vali tikki, hari chatni ke sath
sabudana-aalu ki vrat vali jalebi, bina soda, bina kalar
Comment karein — vrat mein pehle vada ya jalebi? Kaunsa atta use karte hain?
